The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e. Wednesday, October 28, 2026, inter-alia, transacted the following business: 1. Approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with Limited Review Reports received from the Statutory Auditors of the Company. 2. In-Principally approved the proposal for amalgamation of Hyd-Air Engineering Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, with the Company, pursuant to Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013. 3. Noted the completion of tenure of Mr. Mustafa Abid Kachwala as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company with effect from the close of business hours on November 27, 2026. 4. Approved Re-designation of Ms. Drashti Bhil as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company with effect from November 28, 2026, for a period of three (3) years.

EMKAY: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board has approved an investment in the Equity Shares of Emkay Capital Private Limited (ECPL), a wholly owned subsidiary, of amount not exceeding Rs. 30 Crores by way of subscription to Rights Issue of Equity Shares of ECPL having face value of Rs. 10 each, at par, in one or more tranches.

Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board has approved to enter into a Business Transfer Agreement ( BTA ) with Emkay Wealth Advisory Limited, for the carve-out and transfer of the Wealth Management Business of the Company, which includes the distribution business, referral business and other relevant business activities pertaining to wealth Management ( Wealth Management Business ), on a going concern basis through a slump sale on such terms and conditions as detailed in the BTA.
